projection: equirectangular, full 360x180, top row = zenith, bottom row = nadir
color: 8-bit sRGB PNG, view transform Standard, look None

mapping.sun_column: x = 2048 (u = 0.5, horizontal centre of the image)
mapping.blender_world: image centre = Blender +Y, u=0.75 (right) = Blender +X, u=0.25 (left) = Blender -X, u=0/1 = Blender -Y
mapping.gltf_threejs_world: Blender +Y == three.js -Z, Blender +X == three.js +X. three.js equirectUv() (u = atan(dir.z, dir.x)/2pi + 0.5) samples u=0.5 for dir +X, so with an unrotated scene.background/environment the sun appears toward three.js +X; rotate backgroundRotation/environmentRotation .y to aim it elsewhere (verify visually).
mapping.how: panoramic camera rotation_euler = (90deg, 0, 0); Sky Texture sun_rotation = 0 (sun azimuth on Blender +Y).
